item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod pa bzlog pa'i las kyi rgyud chen las zhi ba don gyi sgrub pa'i lag len g.ya' sel dri med
item.coloph: g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung don bsdus pa/ zhi ba rin chen spyi spungs man ngag don gyis bsgrubs (gyi sgrub) pa'i lag len g.ya' sel dri med zhi (zhes) bya ba 'di/ 'phags mchog rin po che'i mched dam paM g.yung drung tshul khrims kyi bka' dang phyag mdzod pa drung mu khi khar gnyis kyi (kyis) bskul ba las brten nas/ thos chung rmongs rgan gsang sngags grags pa la grogs rad na tshul mi'i bgyis te/ dga' ba pad lung gi ljong dga' ldan dpal ri'i 'bangs/ bkra shis smin grol khrod du shing pho stag lo'i zla tshes legs par mgyogs tu (su) bris pa dge legs 'phel/ zhal rta bdun ltar du bon bstan yongs la khyab pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
